hf_papers.abstract: Muon-RT eliminates separate momentum buffers by reusing teacher-student displacement for hidden weight matrices, reducing memory while improving fine-tuning and policy optimization accuracy.

hf_papers.title: Venus-DefakerOne2: A Vision-Forensics Foundation Model with Broader Coverage
hf_papers.abstract: Venus-DefakerOne2 is a unified anti-forgery foundation model that extends detection to diverse forgery forms and media types through alternating LoRA and full-parameter tuning and entropy-based test adaptation.

hf_papers.title: EvoMemState: Evolving Memory State for Personal Agents
hf_papers.abstract: Long-term memory enables large language model (LLM) agents to provide continuous personalized assistance by retaining user information across interactions. Existing systems support this process through fact extraction, organization, updating, and retrieval, but largely maintain memories as independent facts. hf_papers.title: StreamDuo: A Live Commentator and a Research Agent for Unseen Games
hf_papers.abstract: StreamDuo pairs a trainable commentator with a frozen research agent that retrieves game wiki entries to improve cross-game streaming commentary without training on target games.

hf_papers.title: SpecPilot: Autonomous Algorithm Discovery and Systems Optimization for Speculative Decoding
hf_papers.abstract: SpecPilot autonomously discovers deployment-specific algorithms and system optimizations to maximize speculative decoding speedups across diverse models, drafters, and serving regimes without quality loss.

hf_papers.title: CaPtain: A Pipeline for Post-Training Code-as-Policy Robot Agents
hf_papers.abstract: CaPtain trains small open vision-language models via supervised fine-tuning and multi-turn reinforcement learning with a physical critic to perform robot manipulation through code, achieving strong results without frontier models or vision-language-action backbones.

hf_papers.title: Towards Foundation Decision Models: Drex
hf_papers.abstract: Drex open decision models return probability distributions over user-supplied options without autoregressive decoding, using supervised fine-tuning, RLAF, and consistency losses to improve accuracy, robustness, and latency.

hf_papers.title: FLAMIA: FLAsh MIcroscaling Attention for Fast and Causally Safe Training on Blackwell
hf_papers.abstract: FLAMIA accelerates Transformer attention on NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs via MXFP8 and mixed-precision kernels that reduce quantization overhead, prevent causal leakage, and support variable-length packed documents.

hf_papers.title: D3D: Decoupled Diffusion Drafting for Asynchronous Speculative Decoding
hf_papers.abstract: D3D is a standalone diffusion drafter that removes target-model hidden-state dependencies to enable asynchronous speculative decoding with high speedup.

hf_papers.title: TAC-CoT: Tool-Empowered Implicit Chain-of-Thought via Interleaving Explicit Tokens
hf_papers.abstract: TAC-CoT replaces explicit reasoning traces with compact latent segments while preserving textual tokens for tool interactions, improving agentic accuracy and reducing computation.

hf_papers.title: You don't need long context
hf_papers.abstract: Frequent context compaction preserves task accuracy across long-horizon and long-input tasks, suggesting that long-context language models may be unnecessary and motivating semantic state space models.

hf_papers.title: Recursa: Toward Recursively Self-Improving Foundation Model Systems
hf_papers.abstract: Recursa is a self-improving foundation model system that adapts to new domains by recursively learning from its own experience, storing skills and reflections in a knowledge repository, and validating improvements without human supervision or stronger teachers.

hf_papers.title: SpecOPD: Branch-Parallel On-Policy Distillation for Speculative Decoding
hf_papers.abstract: SpecOPD accelerates speculative decoding by parallelizing on-policy draft supervision across independent branches, improving acceptance length and training throughput across diverse model architectures and tasks.

hf_papers.title: Human-to-Robot Transfer via Bridging Representation and Action Space in VLAs
hf_papers.abstract: H2RB adapts pretrained vision-language-action policies to new robots using unpaired human demonstrations via geometry-anchored alignment and a decoupled-decoder tokenizer, substantially improving cross-embodiment skill transfer.

hf_papers.title: PyRUA-REAL: Robot Exploration and Adaptive Learning through RSI in the Real World
hf_papers.abstract: PyRUA-REAL enables coding agents to convert physical robot exploration into persistent executable skills, achieving high success rates across real-world and benchmark tasks through recursive self-improvement.

hf_papers.title: BYOD: Build Your Own DLM - Efficient Autoregressive-to-Diffusion Language Model Conversion
hf_papers.abstract: BYOD converts autoregressive language models into diffusion models via parameter-efficient LoRA adapters, enabling parallel generation with minimal training cost while preserving base-model knowledge.

hf_papers.title: MAServeBench: Benchmarking Multi-Agent LLM Serving Systems with Hierarchical Collaboration Workloads
hf_papers.abstract: MAServeBench evaluates LLM serving and hardware by modeling multi-agent collaboration as a configurable workload dimension with reproducible dependency traces.

hf_papers.title: LoopVQ: Sub 1-bit KV Cache Quantization for Looped Transformers
hf_papers.abstract: Looped transformers are a parameter-efficient alternative to standard transformers for language modeling. By reapplying the same layers across multiple loop steps, recent looped language models match the performance of non-looped models several times their size. While this architecture effectively reduces parameter memory, each loop step still stores its own keys and values, so the key-value (KV)

hf_papers.title: Adversarial Speculative Reasoning Improves Long Horizon Agents
hf_papers.abstract: Speculative decoding can be trained to reject critical reasoning tokens so they are verified by the target model, reducing numerical noise and improving long-horizon agent accuracy without altering the target model.

hf_papers.title: How I Aligned Your Model: Scaling Up Multilingual Safety Training with Templates
hf_papers.abstract: Researchers developed a scalable template-based pipeline to generate multilingual safety datasets, revealing that English-only evaluations misjudge multilingual model safety and that culturally localized training improves alignment across languages.

hf_papers.title: The SIMPLE Law for Energy Cost of LLM Inference
hf_papers.abstract: A four-parameter analytical law predicts LLM inference energy across architectures, revealing quadratic prefill costs, GQA savings, and super-linear growth from reasoning budgets and agentic serving.

hf_papers.title: SleuthVLM: Do We Really Need Audio-in-Video for Omni Video Understanding?
hf_papers.abstract: SleuthVLM uses a vision-language model with transcribed speech and autonomous video sleuthing to outperform direct audio-hearing omni models on long-video benchmarks, showing that agentic reasoning matters more than auditory input.

hf_papers.title: Terminal-style Mathematical Modeling Bench: The First Agentic and Verifiable Benchmark for Mathematical Modeling
hf_papers.abstract: TB-MathModel is a terminal benchmark that makes complete contest-style mathematical modeling problems agentic and verifiable, scoring final numeric answers against multiple human references with feasibility checks.

hf_papers.title: SAE Interprets MoE: Sparse AutoEncoders Reveal That MoE Experts Exhibit Human-Interpretable Fine-Grained Specialization
hf_papers.abstract: A sparse autoencoder trained on mixture-of-experts layer outputs reveals that individual experts drive specific latent features, showing finer-grained and more concentrated specialization than routing or domain labels alone.

hf_papers.title: From Autonomous Agents to Cognitive Symbionts: Toward AI-Augmented Human Intelligence
hf_papers.abstract: Physical AI should include AI-augmented human intelligence via lifelong cognitive symbionts that close cognitive gaps through sensing, context retention, and proactive assistance, requiring embedded governance.

hf_papers.title: Decode Before You Hear: Speculative Listening for Chunk-Interleaved Full-Duplex Speech Language Models
hf_papers.abstract: A training-free, lossless speculative decoding framework exploits idle compute in chunk-interleaved full-duplex speech language models to draft and verify upcoming audio chunks, substantially reducing response and tool-call delays.

hf_papers.title: WeFair: Fidelity-Aware Alignment from Human Feedback for Personalized Query Rewriting in Short-Video Search
hf_papers.abstract: WeFair improves personalized query rewriting via fidelity-aware human feedback stages—demonstration, preference, and verification—to reduce intent drift and boost search effectiveness in short-video platforms.

hf_papers.title: Muir: Linear Attention with Sensitivity-Allocated Gating and Matched-Filter Readout
hf_papers.abstract: A linear attention architecture called Muir allocates gate capacity by sensitivity, uses matched-filter readout and a stable parallel update, improving language modeling, long-context recall, and training speed over Gated DeltaNet-2 and Transformer baselines.

hf_papers.title: LiveFoley: Dynamic Real-Time Video-to-Audio Generation for Immersive Interactive Worlds
hf_papers.abstract: LiveFoley improves streaming video-to-audio generation by using a trailing sliding window for visual alignment and expanded temporal denoising windows for audio quality with minimal latency.

hf_papers.title: VoxLock: Target-Speaker Extraction for Voice Agents Without an Enrollment Step
hf_papers.abstract: A fine-tuned causal target-speaker extraction model achieves near-commercial speech recognition accuracy on real recordings with low CPU usage and latency.

hf_papers.title: SwarmEvolve: Latent Agent Swarms for Evolutionary Discovery and Optimization
hf_papers.abstract: LLM-guided evolutionary search uses AI agents to improve programs for mathematical and computational problems by iteratively refining solutions and combining high-scoring methods. hf_papers.title: StepX-OPD: Rethinking Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation in Diffusion Models
hf_papers.abstract: StepX-OPD jointly trains a text-to-image diffusion model to acquire capabilities and few-step sampling simultaneously, outperforming sequential approaches while reducing training cost.

hf_papers.title: Towards Real-Time Full-Waveform LiDAR Transformers via Intensity-Guided Token Reduction and Physics-Aware Augmentation
hf_papers.abstract: A token pruning and merging mechanism and a waveform-preserving augmentation improve a full-waveform LiDAR Transformer to real-time speed and higher accuracy with better generalization.
